profile.reading:
This is a Digital Realty facility at 1505 Ferris Road, Dallas County, TX, per mapping data. This session's fetch of Digital Realty's Dallas metro property list did not surface a matching named/coded property at this specific address, so no operator-confirmed square footage is reported here.

Digital Realty Trust (NYSE: DLR, SEC CIK 1297996), headquartered at 2323 Bryan Street, Dallas, Texas, reported 310 data centers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, 221 wholly owned or consolidated and 89 in unconsolidated joint ventures, about 57.6 million rentable square feet across more than 55 metro markets including 118 US facilities, per its FY2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC. The company operates as a colocation and wholesale landlord rather than running its own compute, distinguishing it from hyperscaler tenants such as AWS, Google, or Meta, also tracked in this registry.

This building is part of Digital Realty's Dallas-Fort Worth metro portfolio, concentrated in Richardson's Telecom Corridor along East Collins Boulevard, Alma Road, Security Row, and Quality Way, with additional sites elsewhere in Dallas County. Digital Realty's own Dallas metro page, fetched this session, lists numerous named properties across this footprint. Dallas-Fort Worth is one of the largest data center markets in the US, also hosting large AWS, CyrusOne, and QTS campuses tracked elsewhere in this registry; Oncor Electric Delivery is the principal utility serving most of the metro and has flagged large-load data center interconnection requests as a fast-growing category on its system. The company does not publish a consolidated IT power rating in megawatts for individual Dallas-area buildings in the sources reviewed this session.

Digital Realty markets its Dallas properties under its PlatformDIGITAL brand, positioning the metro alongside Northern Virginia, Chicago, Silicon Valley, and New York/New Jersey, all tracked elsewhere in this registry, as core hubs in its global interconnection and colocation platform.

profile.regional_context: Dallas-Fort Worth is among the largest data center markets in the United States, with Richardson's Telecom Corridor and the broader metro hosting large colocation, hyperscale, and enterprise campuses for Digital Realty, CyrusOne, QTS, AWS, and other operators tracked in this registry. reading.body:
Digital Realty operates a multi-building campus at Ferris Road in Garland, Texas, within the Dallas-Fort Worth metro cluster where it holds seven confirmed facilities. The campus includes DFW37, which is built and operational, and DFW40, a ~280,000 square foot building under construction as of 2025. Published capacity for this campus has not been disclosed by the operator.

Because no megawatt figure is published for this facility, its scale relative to Digital Realty's other DFW assets and to the Texas market cannot be calculated from operator spec pages. Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities of which only 18 publish capacity figures totaling 468 MW. This campus would rank 19th among facilities with published figures if it disclosed capacity, meaning it falls below the published threshold in the state.

The campus sits in a region with substantial co-location infrastructure but sparse public capacity disclosure. Whether Ferris Road will matter to AI scaling depends on the megawatt count of DFW37 and DFW40, which the operator has not published. Trade reporting confirms active expansion, but the operator's silence on capacity leaves the site's role in grid-constrained AI growth unquantified.
